description: Find places of a category near coordinates via the OSM Overpass API

category.description: Optional bare OpenStreetMap tag key (letters and underscores only, for example 'amenity') whose tagged nodes to find nearby; defaults to 'amenity'.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90, of the centre point to search around.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of nearby places to return; defaults to 20 and is clamped to 1-100.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180, of the centre point to search around.

radius.description: Optional search radius in metres around the coordinates; defaults to 1000 and must be greater than 0.

name: find_nearby
